title: Diesel 50 Concrete Pump Catalogue Row
description: Diesel 50 is a Xingtai diesel trailer pump listing 6105 diesel 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 450 m (1 cm aggregate), Kawasaki 140, 3300 kg. It is not Diesel 40 (66 kW, 26 m³/h) and not Diesel 60 (144 kW, 35 m³/h). Match the printed table, then inquire.

relatedPaths.label: Diesel concrete pump for sites without electricity

answerBlock.what: Diesel 50 Concrete Pump is a diesel trailer concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: 6105 diesel 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 450 m (1 cm aggregate), hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 140, 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm, 3300 kg. It is not Diesel 40, not Diesel 60 and not a boom pump or mixing plant.
answerBlock.who: Contractors on sites without stable grid power matching 30 m³/h, 30 MPa and 150 m / 450 m (1 cm aggregate) to a trailer diesel pour.
factors: 6105 / 99 kW versus Diesel 40 at 4108 / 66 kW and Diesel 60 at 144 kW
Distance 150 m / 450 m at 1 cm aggregate on this page
Kawasaki 140 hydraulic pump and 3300 kg frame

faqs.question: Is Diesel 50 an electric-catalogue substitute?
faqs.answer: No. Use a diesel row when the site has no stable grid. If grid power already exists, compare the electric hub instead of copying this diesel table.

faqs.question: Does Diesel 50 replace Diesel 40 or Diesel 60?
faqs.answer: No. Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, 120 m / 360 m. Diesel 60 lists 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 350 m, model HBT60-13.132. Match the printed row.
